faq.q: What is the minimum investment amount for InvITs?
faq.a: For public InvITs, the minimum subscription amount can be in the range of ₹10,000 to ₹15,000. Recent SEBI amendments in September 2025 also reduced the minimum investment threshold for InvITs from ₹1 crore to ₹25 lakhs for any investor.
Yes, InvITs are regulated by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) under the SEBI (Infrastructure Investment Trusts) Regulations, 2014.

faq.q: What kind of returns can I expect from InvITs?
faq.a: InvITs aim to provide stable, long-term returns primarily through regular income distributions (dividends/interest) from the operational assets. The actual returns depend on the performance of the underlying assets, market conditions, and tax implications.

faq.q: Can foreign investors invest in Indian InvITs?
faq.a: Yes, any investor, whether domestic or foreign, retail or institutional, can buy InvIT units in India. The recent SEBI approval for Depository Receipts against InvIT units is specifically aimed at facilitating greater foreign capital participation.

faq.q: What types of infrastructure assets do InvITs typically hold?
faq.a: InvITs typically hold assets like toll roads, power transmission lines, gas pipelines, renewable energy projects, and telecom towers. Public InvITs are required to invest at least 80% of their assets in completed and revenue-generating infrastructure projects.
